Additionally, Fluorouracil is also associated with EHEB, which is targeted by Capsianoside Ii, another compound that leads to A549 cell interaction. These findings indicate that Fluorouracil may exert its effects on A549 cells through a chain of molecular targets, potentially involving different pathways or mechanisms. The evidence is consistent with a possible role of Fluorouracil in modulating A549 cell behavior, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated.
